decisions.reason: Product A is close to the firm's established modular sensing offer and the firm conducts in-house R&D, so it can interpret early results and improve it rather than drop it.
Product B builds directly on the firm's existing AC input and Bricklet platform and benefits from the firm's own R&D, making it likely to be retained.
Product C is close to the firm's established relay and modular control offer, and with in-house R&D the firm can assimilate its performance and keep developing it.
Product E builds on the firm's established modular control and LED interface knowledge, so the firm has the related knowledge to learn from its early results and retain it.
Product F extends the firm's established wallbox and energy-management direction, and the firm's in-house R&D supports assimilating feedback from the service.
